verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's own Dashboard guide describes an org-wide dashboard covering review speed, code quality, collaboration patterns, and the impact and ROI of AI-assisted reviews, with a companion page defining every Git-platform review metric. That clearly delivers the core of an engineering lead's org-level visibility story. However, the evidence never names acceptance rates or review coverage among those metrics, so those parts are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of acceptance-rate and review-coverage metrics, a findings breakdown view, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard.
